messages:
ashwin: Ran a perf sweep on prod-dedicated group — seeing periodic 20-40% token latency spikes during PP bubble with 1F1B microbatch=4.
ashwin: spikes line up with all-reduce windows; also KV-cache hotpath shows increased memcpy and kernel fallback to fp32 in traces.
kelsey: hmm. Which kernel selector/version used? could be falling back to generic all-reduce on some ranks.
olga: pasted trace snippet:
```
[pp0] allreduce 12.3ms -> 47.8ms
[pp1] kv_cache_prefetch 4.1ms -> 25.7ms
Kernel: aten::fast_gemm_q4 fallback->fp32_quant
```
samir: microbatch=4, pipeline depth=8? 1F1B should hide comm but if kv prefetch blocks it reintroduces gaps.
perf-bot: auto-profile summary: p99 latency +32%, avg allreduce time +3.9x, kv cache miss rate jumped from 2.1%->8.7% after recent kernel patch.
kelsey: that kernel patch was the "unified-kernel-router" from last week. maybe selection heuristic misroutes quant kernels.
nashwin: reproduces on canary with same model and batch shape. hypothesis: selector prefers new kernel on small seq len -> worse for q4 and triggers memcpy to fp32.
olga: easy test: force old kernel via env override and re-run perf; command:
```
RUNTIME_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=legacy_kernels pytest -q tests/perf/test_pp_bubble.py::test_1f1b_microbatch
```
olga: with override spikes disappear (p99 back to baseline).
samir: ok plan: (1) pin kernel selector for canary, (2) add routing unit test for q4 path, (3) tweak batching heuristic to bias same-kernel batch coalescing.
kelsey: I'll run a microbatch sweep (mb in 2,4,8) and a kv prefetch warmup experiment (prefetch=enabled/disabled) on canary. uploading cmds.
kelsey: commands:
```
./tools/run_pp_sweep --microbatches 2,4,8 --1f1b --warmup-prefetch 0,1 --out perf_logs/
```
ashwin: also let's add an alert if kv cache miss rate >5% during pp bursts. olga can you add a dashboard tile?
olga: will add tile and a canary-derived alert. also open PR to pin selector fallback until we fix.
nashwin: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:30 for results. :thumbsup:
